fact.subject: session.timeout.ms
fact.quotedToken: then the broker will remove this client from the group
fact.note: From the SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS_DOC string (lines 178-184): if no heartbeats are received by the broker before the session timeout expires, the broker removes the client and initiates a rebalance. This is documentation text; the broker code is not among the given files.

fact.subject: session.timeout.ms
fact.note: This is the client's own session timer (Heartbeat.java:48, reset on each received heartbeat at Heartbeat.java:93). It detects that this client's session has lapsed, not another member's failure. On expiry it marks the coordinator unknown (AbstractCoordinator.java:1476-1477) and does not itself remove any member.
